SPIRELAB-THE_WITCH.title: The Witch
SPIRELAB-THE_WITCH.description: She climbs with a broken mirror. Enlightenment draws an extra card each turn and lets her temporarily replace a card in hand.
SPIRELAB-THE_WITCH.eventDeathPrevention: It was the one in the mirror who fell.
SPIRELAB-THE_WITCH.cardsModifierDescript: Witch cards can appear in rewards and shops.
SPIRELAB-THE_WITCH.banter.alive.endTurnP: How much longer must the mirror wait?
